---- MODULE CDiningPhilosophers ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANT N \* number of philosophers (and forks)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Helper definitions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Philosophers == 0 .. N-1

Right(i) == i
Left(i)  == (i - 1) % N   \* modulo arithmetic, works for i = 0

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* State variables
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
VARIABLES sem, pc   \* sem: fork availability (1 = free, 0 = held)
                    \* pc : program counter for each philosopher (0..5)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ sem = [i \in Philosophers |-> 1]   \* all forks free
    /\ pc  = [i \in Philosophers |-> 0]   \* all philosophers at step 0

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions for a single philosopher i
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
AcqFirst(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = 0
    /\ IF i = 0
          THEN /\ sem[Left(i)] = 1
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Left(i)] = 0]
          ELSE /\ sem[Right(i)] = 1
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Right(i)] = 0]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << >>

AcqSecond(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = 1
    /\ IF i = 0
          THEN /\ sem[Right(i)] = 1
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Right(i)] = 0]
          ELSE /\ sem[Left(i)] = 1
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Left(i)] = 0]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = 2]
    /\ UNCHANGED << >>

Eat(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = 2
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = 3]
    /\ UNCHANGED sem

ReleaseRight(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = 3
    /\ IF i = 0
          THEN /\ sem[Right(i)] = 0
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Right(i)] = 1]
          ELSE /\ sem[Right(i)] = 0
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Right(i)] = 1]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = 4]
    /\ UNCHANGED << >>

ReleaseLeft(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = 4
    /\ IF i = 0
          THEN /\ sem[Left(i)] = 0
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Left(i)] = 1]
          ELSE /\ sem[Left(i)] = 0
                /\ sem' = [sem EXCEPT ![Left(i)] = 1]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED << >>

PhiloStep(i) == \/ AcqFirst(i)
                 \/ AcqSecond(i)
                 \/ Eat(i)
                 \/ ReleaseRight(i)
                 \/ ReleaseLeft(i)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Global next relation (exactly one philosopher moves)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Next ==
    \E i \in Philosophers : PhiloStep(i)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification (used only for completeness, not required in the .cfg)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<sem, pc>>

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant: no two adjacent philosophers eat together
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
NoAdjacentEating ==
    \A i \in Philosophers :
        ~( pc[i] = 2 /\ pc[(i + 1) % N] = 2 )

=============================================================================

    Addr,          \* set of addresses
    Data,          \* set of data values
    InitData,      \* initial data value (a member of Data)
    ND,            \* special placeholder, not in Data
    N,             \* number of processors
    InLen,         \* max length of an input queue
    OutLen         \* max length of an output queue

(* ---------- DERIVED CONSTANTS ---------- *)
Proc == 1 .. N               \* processor identifiers

(* ---------- TYPES ---------- *)
Op   == { <<d, a>> : d \in Data, a \in Addr } \cup
        { <<d, a, "*">> : d \in Data, a \in Addr }

Resp == { <<d, a>> : d \in Data, a \in Addr }

(* ---------- VARIABLES ---------- *)
VARIABLES
    mem,    \* [Addr -> Data]
    c,      \* [Proc -> [Addr -> (Data \cup {ND})]]
    inQ,    \* [Proc -> Seq(Op)]   (input queues)
    out    \* [Proc -> Seq(Resp)] (output queues)

(* ---------- INITIAL STATE ---------- *)

    /\ c   = [p \in Proc |-> [a \in Addr |-> ND]]
    /\ inQ = [p \in Proc |-> <<>>]
    /\ out = [p \in Proc |-> <<>>]

(* ---------- ACTIONS ---------- *)

DoNothing ==
    UNCHANGED <<mem, c, inQ, out>>

WriteMem ==
    \E a \in Addr, d \in Data :
        /\ mem' = [mem EXCEPT ![a] = d]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<c, inQ, out>>

UpdateCache(p) ==
    \E a \in Addr, v \in Data \cup {ND} :
        /\ c' = [c EXCEPT ![p][a] = v]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<mem, inQ, out>>

EnqResp(p) ==
    /\ Len(out[p]) < OutLen
    /\ \E d \in Data, a \in Addr :
        /\ out' = [out EXCEPT ![p] = Append(out[p], <<d, a>>)]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<mem, c, inQ>>

EnqOp(p) ==
    /\ Len(inQ[p]) < InLen
    /\ \E op \in Op :
        /\ inQ' = [inQ EXCEPT ![p] = Append(inQ[p], op)]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<mem, c, out>>

DeqResp(p) ==
    /\ Len(out[p]) > 0
    /\ out' = [out EXCEPT ![p] = Tail(out[p])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mem, c, inQ>>

DeqOp(p) ==
    /\ Len(inQ[p]) > 0
    /\ inQ' = [inQ EXCEPT ![p] = Tail(inQ[p])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mem, c, out>>

PerProc(p) ==
    \/ UpdateCache(p)
    \/ EnqResp(p)
    \/ EnqOp(p)
    \/ DeqResp(p)
    \/ DeqOp(p)

Next ==
    \/ DoNothing
    \/ WriteMem
    \/ \E p \in Proc : PerProc(p)

(* ---------- SAFETY INVARIANT ---------- *)

SystemInvariant ==
    /\ \A a \in Addr : mem[a] \in Data
    /\ \A p \in Proc, a \in Addr :
            c[p][a] = ND \/ c[p][a] = mem[a]
    /\ \A p \in Proc :
            Len(inQ[p]) <= InLen
            /\ \A i \in DOMAIN inQ[p] : inQ[p][i] \in Op
    /\ \A p \in Proc :
            Len(out[p]) <= OutLen
            /\ \A i \in DOMAIN out[p] : out[p][i] \in Resp

(* ---------- SPECIFICATION ---------- *)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<mem, c, inQ, out>>

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Set of processes (concrete model uses three processes 0,1,2)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
Proc == 0..2

VARIABLES pc, want

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Type invariant (helps TLC, not part of the safety property)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
TypeInvariant ==
  /\ pc \in [Proc -> {"idle", "requesting", "waiting", "cs"}]
  /\ want \in [Proc -> BOOLEAN]

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Initial state
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
Init ==
  /\ pc = [p \in Proc |-> "idle"]
  /\ want = [p \in Proc |-> FALSE]

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Individual actions (one process at a time)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* stay in non‑critical work, does not change any variable *)
NonCriticalStep(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "idle"
  /\ pc' = pc
  \/ want' = want

(* announce request for the critical section *)
StartRequest(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "idle"
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "requesting"]
  /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]

(* move from requesting to waiting (no shared variable change) *)
Wait(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "requesting"
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "waiting"]
  /\ want' = want

(* enter critical section when no other process is requesting *)
EnterCS(p) ==

  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "cs"]
  /\ want' = want

(* leave critical section and clear request flag *)
ExitCS(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "cs"
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
  /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   Next-state relation (interleaving of the actions)

ReadOps  == { [op |-> "R", d |-> d, a |-> a] : d \in Data, a \in Addr }

---- MODULE Euclid3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC

CONSTANT N

VARIABLES u, v, v_ini, pc

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Recursive definition of the greatest common divisor
RECURSIVE GCD(_,_)

GCD(a, b) ==
  IF b = 0 THEN a ELSE GCD(b, a % b)

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state: the environment chooses v_ini ∈ 1..N
Init ==
  /\ u = 24
  /\ v_ini \in 1..N
  /\ v = v_ini
  /\ pc = "lp"

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Loop‑head action
Lp ==
  /\ pc = "lp"
  /\ IF u = 0 THEN
        /\ pc' = "Done"
        /\ UNCHANGED <<u, v, v_ini>>
     ELSE
        /\ IF u < v
              THEN /\ u' = v
                   /\ v' = u
              ELSE /\ u' = u
                   /\ v' = v
        /\ pc' = "a"
        /\ UNCHANGED v_ini

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Subtraction action
A ==
  /\ pc = "a"
  /\ u >= v
  /\ u' = u - v
  /\ v' = v
  /\ v_ini' = v_ini
  /\ pc' = "lp"

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Stuttering action in the terminal state
Done ==
  /\ pc = "Done"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<u, v, v_ini, pc>>

Next == Lp \/ A \/ Done

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant: the GCD of the current operands never changes
SafetyInv == GCD(u, v) = GCD(24, v_ini)

\* -----------------------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<u, v, v_ini, pc>>

THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

(* turn    : Proc   – the current turn value                               *)
(* pc[i]   : {"idle", "wait", "critical"} – abstract program counter       *)
(* savedTurn[i] : Nat – the value of 'turn' that process i recorded when it

    /\ turn \in Proc

    /\ pc[i] = "idle"
    /\ flag'      = [flag EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ savedTurn' = [savedTurn EXCEPT ![i] = turn]
    /\ pc'        = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "wait"]
    /\ UNCHANGED turn

Wait(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "wait"
    /\ ( (\E j \in Proc : j # i /\ flag[j] /\ turn = j )

    /\ UNCHANGED <<flag, turn, pc, savedTurn>>

Enter(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "wait"
    /\ ~ ( (\E j \in Proc : j # i /\ flag[j] /\ turn = j )
          \/ (turn = savedTurn[i]) )
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "critical"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flag, turn, savedTurn>>

    /\ flag'      = [flag EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]

    /\ savedTurn' = [savedTurn EXCEPT ![i] = -1]

    \/ \E i \in Proc : Exit(i)

CONSTANTS
    Producers,   \* non‑empty set of producer identifiers
    Consumers,   \* non‑empty set of consumer identifiers
    BufCapacity  \* positive integer, maximum buffer size

VARIABLES
    buffer,      \* sequence of producer ids (FIFO queue)
    waitP,       \* set of producers that are blocked because the buffer is full
    waitC        \* set of consumers that are blocked because the buffer is empty

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Helper definitions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
BufFull  == Len(buffer) = BufCapacity
BufEmpty == Len(buffer) = 0

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ buffer = <<>>
    /\ waitP  = {}
    /\ waitC  = {}

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Produce action performed by a producer p
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Produce(p) ==
    /\ p \in Producers
    /\ p \notin waitP
    /\ IF BufFull
          THEN /\ buffer' = buffer
               /\ waitP'  = waitP \cup {p}
               \/ waitC'  = waitC
          ELSE /\ buffer' = Append(buffer, p)
               /\ waitP'  = waitP
               /\ IF waitC = {}
                     THEN waitC' = {}
                     ELSE waitC' = waitC \ { CHOOSE c \in waitC : TRUE }

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Consume action performed by a consumer c
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Consume(c) ==
    /\ c \in Consumers
    /\ c \notin waitC
    /\ IF BufEmpty
          THEN /\ buffer' = buffer
               /\ waitC'  = waitC \cup {c}
               /\ waitP'  = waitP
          ELSE /\ buffer' = Tail(buffer)      \* remove the head element
               /\ waitC'  = waitC
               /\ IF waitP = {}
                     THEN waitP' = {}
                     ELSE waitP' = waitP \ { CHOOSE p \in waitP : TRUE }

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Producers : Produce(p)
    \/ \E c \in Consumers : Consume(c)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
vars == << buffer, waitP, waitC >>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant: it is never the case that **all** producers
\* and **all** consumers are waiting simultaneously.
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
NoDeadlock == ~( (waitP = Producers) /\ (waitC = Consumers) )

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* THEOREM (optional, states that the invariant holds under Spec)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []NoDeadlock

---- MODULE Bug2750 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS
    Producers,   \* non‑empty set of producer identifiers
    Consumers,   \* non‑empty set of consumer identifiers
    BufCapacity  \* positive integer, maximum buffer size

VARIABLES
    buffer,      \* sequence of producer ids (FIFO queue)
    waitP,       \* set of producers that are blocked because the buffer is full
    waitC        \* set of consumers that are blocked because the buffer is empty

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Helper definitions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
BufFull  == Len(buffer) = BufCapacity
BufEmpty == Len(buffer) = 0

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ buffer = <<>>
    /\ waitP  = {}
    /\ waitC  = {}

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Produce action performed by a producer p
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Produce(p) ==
    /\ p \in Producers
    /\ p \notin waitP
    /\ IF BufFull
          THEN /\ buffer' = buffer
               /\ waitP'  = waitP \cup {p}
               /\ waitC'  = waitC
          ELSE /\ buffer' = Append(buffer, p)
               /\ waitP'  = waitP
               /\ IF waitC = {}
                     THEN waitC' = {}
                     ELSE waitC' = waitC \ { CHOOSE c \in waitC : TRUE }

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Consume action performed by a consumer c
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Consume(c) ==
    /\ c \in Consumers
    /\ c \notin waitC
    /\ IF BufEmpty
          THEN /\ buffer' = buffer
               /\ waitC'  = waitC \cup {c}
               /\ waitP'  = waitP
          ELSE /\ buffer' = Tail(buffer)      \* remove the head element
               /\ waitC'  = waitC
               /\ IF waitP = {}
                     THEN waitP' = {}
                     ELSE waitP' = waitP \ { CHOOSE p \in waitP : TRUE }

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Producers : Produce(p)
    \/ \E c \in Consumers : Consume(c)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
vars == << buffer, waitP, waitC >>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant: it is never the case that **all** producers
\* and **all** consumers are waiting simultaneously.
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
NoDeadlock == ~( (waitP = Producers) /\ (waitC = Consumers) )

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* THEOREM (optional, states that the invariant holds under Spec)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []NoDeadlock

====

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences, TLC

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Constants (to be instantiated in the .cfg file)
\* -------------------------------------------------
CONSTANTS Slots, Values

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Variables
\* -------------------------------------------------
VARIABLES proposed, chosen

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Type definitions
\* -------------------------------------------------
\* proposed is a subset of the global pool of Values
Proposed == proposed \in SUBSET Values

\* chosen maps each slot to a set of values
\* each set is either empty or a singleton
Chosen == 
    /\ chosen \in [Slots -> SUBSET Values]
    /\ \A s \in Slots : 
        \/ chosen[s] = {}
        \/ \E v \in Values : chosen[s] = {v}

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* -------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ proposed = {}
    /\ chosen = [s \in Slots |-> {}]

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Actions
\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Propose a previously un‑proposed value
Propose ==
    /\ \E v \in Values : v \notin proposed
    /\ LET v == CHOOSE w \in Values : w \notin proposed IN
       /\ proposed' = proposed \cup {v}
       /\ UNCHANGED chosen

\* Choose a value for an empty slot from the set of proposed values
Choose ==
    /\ \E s \in Slots : chosen[s] = {}
    /\ \E s \in Slots : 
        /\ chosen[s] = {}
        \/ \E v \in proposed :
            /\ chosen' = [chosen EXCEPT ![s] = {v}]
            /\ UNCHANGED proposed

\* Stutter step to avoid deadlock when no other action is enabled
Stutter == UNCHANGED <<proposed, chosen>>

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* -------------------------------------------------
Next == \/ Propose
        \/ Choose

\* -------------------------------------------------

\* -------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

---- MODULE ConsensusMulti ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences, TLC

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Constants (to be instantiated in the .cfg file)
\* -------------------------------------------------
CONSTANTS Slots, Values

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Variables
\* -------------------------------------------------
VARIABLES proposed, chosen

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Type definitions
\* -------------------------------------------------
\* proposed is a subset of the global pool of Values
Proposed == proposed \in SUBSET Values

\* chosen maps each slot to a set of values
\* each set is either empty or a singleton
Chosen == 
    /\ chosen \in [Slots -> SUBSET Values]
    /\ \A s \in Slots : 
        \/ chosen[s] = {}
        \/ \E v \in Values : chosen[s] = {v}

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* -------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ proposed = {}
    /\ chosen = [s \in Slots |-> {}]

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Actions
\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Propose a previously un‑proposed value
Propose ==
    /\ \E v \in Values : v \notin proposed
    /\ LET v == CHOOSE w \in Values : w \notin proposed IN
       /\ proposed' = proposed \cup {v}
       /\ UNCHANGED chosen

\* Choose a value for an empty slot from the set of proposed values
Choose ==
    /\ \E s \in Slots :
        /\ chosen[s] = {}
        /\ \E v \in proposed :
            /\ chosen' = [chosen EXCEPT ![s] = {v}]
            /\ proposed' = proposed

\* Stutter step to avoid deadlock when no other action is enabled
Stutter == UNCHANGED <<proposed, chosen>>

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* -------------------------------------------------
Next == \/ Propose
        \/ Choose
        \/ Stutter

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\* -------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<proposed, chosen>>

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant (captures all four safety conditions)
\* -------------------------------------------------
SafetyInv ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots :
          /\ chosen[s] \subseteq proposed           \* non‑triviality
          /\ (chosen[s] = {} \/ \E v \in Values : chosen[s] = {v})  \* at most one value, well‑typed

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* THEOREM (for TLC checking)
\* -------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

---- MODULE TwoPhase_MC ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS RMs

(* --- Enumerated domains ----------------------------------- *)
RMStates == {"working", "prepared", "committed", "aborted"}
TMStates == {"init", "done"}
MsgTypes == {"prepare", "commit", "abort", "prepared"}

Message == [type : MsgTypes, dst : (RMs \cup {"TM"})]

(* --- Variables ------------------------------------------- *)
VARIABLES rmState, tmState, tmPrepared, abortSeen, msgs

(* --- Helper definitions ----------------------------------- *)
RMsSet == RMs

(* --- Initial state ---------------------------------------- *)
Init ==
    /\ rmState = [r \in RMsSet |-> "working"]
    /\ tmState = "init"
    /\ tmPrepared = {}
    /\ abortSeen = FALSE
    /\ msgs = {}

(* --- Actions --------------------------------------------- *)

(* 1. TM broadcasts a prepare request to every RM *)
Start ==
    /\ tmState = "init"
    /\ \A r \in RMsSet: << "prepare", r >> \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<< "prepare", r >> : r \in RMsSet}
    /\ UNCHANGED << rmState, tmState, tmPrepared, abortSeen >>

(* 2. An RM consumes its prepare message, stays working *)
RMReceivePrepare ==
    \E r \in RMsSet :
        /\ rmState[r] = "working"
        /\ << "prepare", r >> \in msgs
        /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<< "prepare", r >>}
        /\ UNCHANGED << rmState, tmState, tmPrepared, abortSeen >>

(* 3. RM decides to cooperate and sends prepared *)
RMVotePrepared ==
    \E r \in RMsSet :
        /\ rmState[r] = "working"
        /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "prepared"]
        /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<< "prepared", r >>}
        /\ UNCHANGED << tmState, tmPrepared, abortSeen >>

(* 4. RM decides to abort and sends abort *)
RMVoteAbort ==
    \E r \in RMsSet :
        /\ rmState[r] = "working"
        /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "aborted"]
        /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<< "abort", r >>}
        /\ UNCHANGED << tmState, tmPrepared, abortSeen >>

(* 5. TM receives a prepared acknowledgement *)
TMCollectPrepared ==
    \E r \in RMsSet :
        /\ << "prepared", r >> \in msgs
        /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<< "prepared", r >>}
        /\ tmPrepared' = tmPrepared \cap {r}
        /\ UNCHANGED << rmState, tmState, abortSeen >>

(* 6. TM receives an abort message *)
TMDetectAbort ==
    \E r \in RMsSet :
        /\ << "abort", r >> \in msgs
        /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<< "abort", r >>}
        /\ abortSeen' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED << rmState, tmState, tmPrepared >>

(* 7. TM decides to commit (all prepared, no abort seen) *)
TMDecideCommit ==
    /\ tmState = "init"
    /\ tmPrepared = RMsSet

Get(t) ==
    /\ t \in Consumers
    /\ IF Len(buf) > 0
          THEN
              /\ buf' = Tail(buf)
              /\ ( /\ wait = {} /\ wait' = wait
                  \/ \E w \in wait : /\ wait' = wait \ {w} )
          ELSE
              /\ buf' = buf
              /\ wait' = wait \cup {t}

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Notify one waiting thread
Notify ==
    /\ wait # {}
    /\ \E w \in wait :
          /\ wait' = wait \ {w}
          /\ UNCHANGED buf

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Notify all waiting threads (unused directly but defined)
NotifyAll ==
    /\ wait' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED buf

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* The overall next-state relation
Next ==
    \/ \E t \in (RunningThreads \cap Producers) : Put(t)
    \/ \E t \in (RunningThreads \cap Consumers) : Get(t)
    \/ Notify
    \/ NotifyAll

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant (the property to be checked)
SafetyInv ==
    /\ Len(buf) >= 0
    /\ Len(buf) <= BufCapacity
    /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(buf) : buf[i] \in Data
    /\ wait \subseteq PARTICIPANTS
    /\ PARTICIPANTS \ wait # {}          \* at least one participant is not waiting

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<buf, wait>>

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* THEOREM (for TLC checking)
THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

---- MODULE ABSpec ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANT DataSet

VARIABLES AVar, BVar

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Types *)
TypeOK ==
    /\ AVar \in DataSet \X {0,1}
    /\ BVar \in DataSet \X {0,1}

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Initial state: choose any data value, set bit to 1, both vars equal *)
Init ==
    \E v \in DataSet :
        /\ AVar = <<v, 1>>
        /\ BVar = AVar

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Send action: allowed only when AVar and BVar agree *)
Send ==
    /\ AVar = BVar
    /\ \E v \in DataSet :
        /\ AVar' = <<v, 1 - AVar[2]>>
        /\ UNCHANGED BVar

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Receive action: allowed only when the bits differ (i.e., vars disagree) *)
Receive ==
    /\ AVar # BVar
    /\ AVar[2] # BVar[2]
    /\ BVar' = AVar
    /\ UNCHANGED AVar

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
Next == Send \/ Receive

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<AVar, BVar>>

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Safety invariant: equal bits imply the whole messages are equal *)
SafeInv == (AVar[2] = BVar[2]) => (AVar = BVar)

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
THEOREM Spec => []SafeInv

---- MODULE AdaptiveK ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS
    K_BUGFIX,
    K_INTEGRATION,
    K_TESTFAIL,
    K_PERFORMANCE,
    K_DEFAULT

VARIABLES
    queryCat,
    k

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* The set of allowed categories
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Categories == {"bugfix", "integration", "testfail",
               "performance", "generic", "metrics"}

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Mapping from a category to its admissible k value
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
kOf ==
    [c \in Categories |->
        IF c \in {"bugfix", "integration"}   THEN K_BUGFIX
        ELSE IF c \in {"testfail", "performance"} THEN K_TESTFAIL
        ELSE K_DEFAULT]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state: choose any allowed category and set k accordingly
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ queryCat \in Categories
    /\ k = kOf[queryCat]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Next action: nondeterministically pick a (possibly new) category
\* and recompute k using the same mapping
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Next ==
    \E newCat \in Categories :
        /\ queryCat' = newCat
        /\ k'        = kOf[newCat]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Behaviour specification
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<queryCat, k>>

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant required by the problem statement
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
SafetyInv ==
    /\ k \notin {5, 10, 20}
    /\ 3 <= k /\ k <= 50
    /\ (queryCat \in {"bugfix", "integration"} => k = 5)
    /\ (queryCat \in {"testfail", "performance"} => k = 20)
    /\ (queryCat \notin {"bugfix", "integration",
                         "testfail", "performance"} => k = 10)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Theorem (optional, helps TLC) that Spec implies the invariant
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

====

---- MODULE spec ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC

CONSTANTS Data

VARIABLES val, rdy, ack

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Safety invariant: the data value is always in Data and the flags  *)
(* are always 0 or 1. This is the semantic safety property required. *)
(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
SafetyInvariant ==
    /\ val \in Data
    /\ rdy \in {0, 1}
    /\ ack \in {0, 1}

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Initial state: arbitrary data value; rdy chosen arbitrarily; ack   *)
(* aligned with rdy.                                                  *)
(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
Init ==
    /\ val \in Data
    /\ rdy \in {0, 1}
    /\ ack = rdy

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Send action: possible only when rdy = ack; a new data value is     *)
(* chosen, rdy is flipped, ack stays unchanged.                       *)
(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
Send ==
    /\ rdy = ack
    /\ UNCHANGED ack
    /\ val' \in Data
    /\ rdy' = 1 - rdy
    /\ ack' = ack

(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
(* Receive action: possible only when rdy # ack; ack is flipped,      *)
(* val and rdy remain unchanged.                                      *)
(*-------------------------------------------------------------------*)
Receive ==
    /\ rdy # ack
    /\ rdy' = rdy
    /\ ack' = 1 - ack
    /\ UNCHANGED val

Next ==
    \/ Send
    \/ Receive

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<val, rdy, ack>>

=============================================================================

\* Variables
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

\* Helper definitions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* The set of tasks currently in a given logical state

\* Type correctness (not the safety property)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /\ RState \in Nat
  /\ WState \in 0..2
  /\ Lock \in [TASKS -> State]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /\ RState = 0
  /\ WState = 0
  /\ Lock = [t \in TASKS |-> "Waiting"]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
RAquire(t) ==
  \/ /\ Lock[t] = "Waiting"
        /\ WState = 0                 \* No writer present
        /\ RState' = RState + 1
        /\ WState' = WState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Read"]
  \/ /\ Lock[t] = "Write"
        /\ WState = 0                 \* No other writer
        /\ RState' = RState + 1
        /\ WState' = WState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "WriteRead"]

WAquire(t) ==
  /\ Lock[t] = "Waiting"
  /\ RState = 0
  /\ WState = 0
  /\ RState' = RState
  /\ WState' = 1
  /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Write"]

        /\ RState > 0
        /\ RState' = RState - 1
        /\ WState' = WState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Finished"]
  \/ /\ Lock[t] = "WriteRead"
        /\ RState > 0
        /\ RState' = RState - 1
        /\ WState' = WState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Write"]

WRelease(t) ==
  \/ /\ Lock[t] = "Write"
        /\ WState > 0
        /\ WState' = WState - 1
        /\ RState' = RState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Finished"]
  \/ /\ Lock[t] = "WriteRead"
        /\ WState > 0
        /\ WState' = WState - 1
        /\ RState' = RState
        /\ Lock' = [Lock EXCEPT ![t] = "Read"]

  /\ \A t \in TASKS : Lock[t] = "Finished"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<RState, WState, Lock>>

                ELSE IF m = "TEXT_40x25" THEN 320 
                ELSE 320]               \* MODE_13h 320 pixels wide
ModeHeight == [m \in VideoModes |-> 
                IF m = "TEXT_80x25" THEN 400 
                ELSE IF m = "TEXT_40x25" THEN 200 
                ELSE 200]               \* MODE_13h 200 pixels high

\* State variables
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    videoMode,        \* current display mode
    textColumns,      \* columns of the text screen
    textRows,         \* rows of the text screen
    rgbWidth,         \* width of the RGB framebuffer (pixels)
    rgbHeight,        \* height of the RGB framebuffer (pixels)
    rgbBufferSize,    \* size of the RGB buffer in bytes (0 or full)
    frameDirty,       \* TRUE ⇔ the displayed frame has been modified
    activeBackend     \* currently selected rendering backend

\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /\ videoMode      = "TEXT_80x25"
    /\ textColumns    = ModeCols[videoMode]
    /\ textRows       = ModeRows[videoMode]
    /\ rgbWidth       = ModeWidth[videoMode]
    /\ rgbHeight      = ModeHeight[videoMode]
    /\ rgbBufferSize  = 0
    /\ frameDirty     = TRUE
    /\ activeBackend  = "Headless"

\* Actions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /\ m \in VideoModes
    /\ videoMode'      = m
    /\ textColumns'    = ModeCols[m]
    /\ textRows'       = ModeRows[m]
    /\ rgbWidth'       = ModeWidth[m]
    /\ rgbHeight'      = ModeHeight[m]
    /\ rgbBufferSize'  = 0
    /\ frameDirty'     = TRUE
    /\ activeBackend'  = activeBackend

WriteChar ==
    /\ frameDirty' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << videoMode, textColumns, textRows,
                    rgbWidth, rgbHeight, rgbBufferSize,
                    activeBackend >>

CaptureText ==
    /\ frameDirty' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << videoMode, textColumns, textRows,
                    rgbWidth, rgbHeight, rgbBufferSize,
                    activeBackend >>

CaptureRGB ==
    /\ rgbBufferSize' = rgbWidth * rgbHeight * 3
    /\ frameDirty'    = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << videoMode, textColumns, textRows,
                    rgbWidth, rgbHeight, activeBackend >>

SwitchBackend(b) ==
    /\ b \in Backends
    /\ activeBackend' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED << videoMode, textColumns, textRows,

CONSTANT NumClients

CLIENTS == 1 .. NumClients

VARIABLES msgs, clients, received

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Type constraints (helpful for debugging; not part of the safety property)
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeOK ==
    /\ msgs \in SUBSET CLIENTS
    /\ clients \in [CLIENTS -> {"SendMessage", "Done"}]
    /\ received \in Seq(CLIENTS)

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ clients = [c \in CLIENTS |-> "SendMessage"]
    /\ received = << >>

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Send(c) ==
    /\ clients[c] = "SendMessage"
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {c}
    /\ clients' = [clients EXCEPT ![c] = "Done"]
    /\ received' = received

Receive ==
    /\ \E m \in msgs :
        /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
        /\ received' = Append(received, m)
        /\ UNCHANGED clients

Terminate ==
    /\ \A c \in CLIENTS : clients[c] = "Done"
    /\ UNCHANGED << msgs, clients, received >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in CLIENTS : Send(c)
    \/ Receive
    \/ Terminate

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant: every entry in the received list is unique
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
UniqueReceived ==
    \A i, j \in 1 .. Len(received) :
        (i # j) => received[i] # received[j]

---- MODULE SetSndRcv_NoFullDrop_11 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANT Values

VARIABLES Buffer, Sent, Received

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived constant: maximum number of elements the buffer may hold          *)
Cap == Cardinality(Values) - 1

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Initial state                                                          *)
Init ==
    /\ Buffer   = {}
    /\ Sent     = {}
    /\ Received = {}

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Send action: add a fresh value when the buffer is not full               *)
Send ==
    /\ Cardinality(Buffer) < Cap
    /\ \E v \in Values \ Buffer :
          /\ Buffer'   = Buffer \cup {v}
          /\ Sent'     = Sent   \cup {v}
          /\ UNCHANGED Received

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Receive action: remove any value that is currently buffered               *)
Receive ==
    /\ \E v \in Buffer :
          /\ Buffer'   = Buffer \ {v}
          /\ Received' = Received \cup {v}
          /\ UNCHANGED Sent

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The nondeterministic step relation                                        *)
Next == Send \/ Receive

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Full specification                                                       *)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<Buffer, Sent, Received>>

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Safety invariant described in the natural‑language text                  *)
BufferSafety ==
    /\ Buffer \subseteq Values               \* only allowed values, no duplicates
    /\ Cardinality(Buffer) <= Cap            \* never exceeds capacity
    /\ Received \subseteq Sent               \* nothing is received before being sent

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets, TLC

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Variables
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------

\* Constants for readability
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------

Right  == "R"

Down   == "down"
A      == "A"
B      == "B"

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    /\ leftPos  = Down
    /\ rightPos = Down
    /\ aEating  = FALSE
    /\ bEating  = FALSE

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Helper: a philosopher is not eating
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
NotEating(p) ==
    IF p = A THEN ~aEating
    ELSE ~bEating

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions for Aristotle (A)
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
AGrabLeft ==
    /\ leftPos = Down
    /\ leftPos' = A
    /\ UNCHANGED << rightPos, aEating, bEating >>

AGrabRight ==
    /\ rightPos = Down
    /\ rightPos' = A
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, aEating, bEating >>

ADropLeft ==
    /\ leftPos = A
    /\ aEating = FALSE               \* cannot drop while eating
    /\ leftPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED << rightPos, aEating, bEating >>

ADropRight ==
    /\ rightPos = A
    /\ aEating = FALSE
    /\ rightPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, aEating, bEating >>

AStartEating ==
    /\ leftPos = A
    /\ rightPos = A
    /\ aEating = FALSE
    /\ aEating' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, rightPos, bEating >>

AStopEating ==
    /\ aEating = TRUE
    /\ aEating' = FALSE
    /\ leftPos' = Down
    /\ rightPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED bEating

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions for Bertrand (B)
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
BGrabLeft ==
    /\ leftPos = Down
    /\ leftPos' = B
    /\ UNCHANGED << rightPos, aEating, bEating >>

BGrabRight ==
    /\ rightPos = Down
    /\ rightPos' = B
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, aEating, bEating >>

BDropLeft ==
    /\ leftPos = B
    /\ bEating = FALSE
    /\ leftPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED << rightPos, aEating, bEating >>

BDropRight ==
    /\ rightPos = B
    /\ bEating = FALSE
    /\ rightPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, aEating, bEating >>

BStartEating ==
    /\ leftPos = B
    /\ rightPos = B
    /\ bEating = FALSE
    /\ bEating' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << leftPos, rightPos, aEating >>

BStopEating ==
    /\ bEating = TRUE
    /\ bEating' = FALSE
    /\ leftPos' = Down
    /\ rightPos' = Down
    /\ UNCHANGED aEating

\* Next-state relation
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------

    \/ AGrabLeft
    \/ AGrabRight
    \/ ADropLeft
    \/ ADropRight
    \/ AStartEating
    \/ AStopEating
    \/ BGrabLeft
    \/ BGrabRight
    \/ BDropLeft
    \/ BDropRight
    \/ BStartEating
    \/ BStopEating

\* Safety invariant (the property required by the description)

    /\ (rightPos = Down \/ rightPos = A \/ rightPos = B)

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leftPos, rightPos, aEating, bEating>>

\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
\* THEOREM (optional, for model checking)
\*--------------------------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []Safety

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ----- Constants ------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTANT MaxEvents \* bound on the size of the event queue (assigned in the .cfg)

\* ----- Types ---------------------------------------------------------------
EventType == {"timer", "kbd", "dma"}

Event == [ id     : Nat,
           deadline: Nat,
           type    : EventType,
           payload : Nat,
           tieKey  : Nat ]

State == [ time    : Nat,
           evts    : SUBSET Event,
           cpuFlag : BOOLEAN,
           pic     : 0..255 ]

Snap  == [ time    : Nat,
           evts    : SUBSET Event,
           cpuFlag : BOOLEAN,
           pic     : 0..255,
           version : Nat,
           crc     : Nat ]

\* ----- Variables -----------------------------------------------------------
VARIABLES state,            \* current in‑memory state
          has_snap,         \* TRUE iff a snapshot is stored
          snap,             \* stored snapshot (valid only when has_snap = TRUE)
          has_loaded,       \* TRUE iff a snapshot has been successfully loaded
          loaded,           \* state obtained by loading the snapshot
          corrupted,        \* TRUE iff the stored snapshot has been tampered with
          saveAborted       \* TRUE iff the most recent save was aborted

\* ----- Helper definitions --------------------------------------------------
\* observable projection of a state (or snapshot)
Obs(s) == [ time    |-> s.time,
            evts    |-> s.evts,
            cpuFlag |-> s.cpuFlag,
            pic     |-> s.pic ]

\* deterministic checksum (mod 256) computed from observable fields
CRCFromState(s) ==
  ( s.time + Cardinality(s.evts) +
    (IF s.cpuFlag THEN 1 ELSE 0) + s.pic ) % 256

CRCFromSnap(s) ==
  ( s.time + Cardinality(s.evts) +
    (IF s.cpuFlag THEN 1 ELSE 0) + s.pic ) % 256

\* ----- Initialization -------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
  /\ state = [ time    |-> 0,
              evts    |-> {},
              cpuFlag |-> FALSE,
              pic     |-> 0 ]
  /\ has_snap = FALSE
  /\ snap = [ time    |-> 0,
              evts    |-> {},
              cpuFlag |-> FALSE,
              pic     |-> 0,
              version |-> 0,
              crc     |-> 0 ]
  /\ has_loaded = FALSE
  /\ loaded = [ time    |-> 0,
               evts    |-> {},
               cpuFlag |-> FALSE,
               pic     |-> 0 ]
  /\ corrupted = FALSE
  /\ saveAborted = FALSE

\* ----- Actions --------------------------------------------------------------

\* Successful save (writes a complete snapshot)
Save ==
  /\ ~has_snap
  /\ ~saveAborted
  /\ has_snap' = TRUE
  /\ snap' = [ time    |-> state.time,
              evts    |-> state.evts,
              cpuFlag |-> state.cpuFlag,
              pic     |-> state.pic,
              version |-> 3,
              crc     |-> CRCFromState(state) ]
  /\ saveAborted' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, has_loaded, loaded, corrupted>>

\* Abort a save in the middle – no snapshot must remain
SaveAbort ==
  /\ ~has_snap
  /\ saveAborted' = TRUE
  /\ has_snap' = FALSE
  /\ corrupted' = FALSE
  /\ has_loaded' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, snap, loaded>>

\* Load a clean, uncorrupted snapshot
Load ==

  /\ ~corrupted
  /\ ~saveAborted
  /\ snap.version = 3
  /\ snap.crc = CRCFromSnap(snap)

  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, has_snap, snap, corrupted, saveAborted>>

\* Corrupt the stored snapshot (e.g., bit‑flip)
CorruptSnapshot ==

  /\ has_loaded' = FALSE

\* Attempt to load a corrupted snapshot – must have no effect
LoadCorrupted ==

\* Diagnostic verification – does not change state
Verify ==
  /\ has_loaded
  /\ ~corrupted
  \/ UNCHANGED <<state, has_snap, snap, has_loaded, loaded, corrupted, saveAborted>>

\* No‑op
Idle ==
  UNCHANGED <<state, has_snap, snap, has_loaded, loaded, corrupted, saveAborted>>

Next ==
  \/ Save
  \/ SaveAbort
  \/ Load
  \/ CorruptSnapshot
  \/ LoadCorrupted
  \/ Verify
  \/ Idle

\* ----- Safety invariants ----------------------------------------------------

\* Main safety property: a loaded, uncorrupted snapshot reproduces exactly the
\* observable part of the state that was saved.
SaveLoadObsPreserve ==

\* CRC consistency for a clean snapshot
CRCInvariant ==
  (has_snap /\ ~corrupted) => (snap.crc = CRCFromSnap(snap))

\* A corrupted snapshot can never be successfully loaded

          snap,             \* stored snapshot (valid only when has_snap = TRUE)

    (IF s.cpuFlag THEN 1 ELSE 0) + s.pic ) % 256

  ( s.time + Cardinality(s.evts) +
    (IF s.cpuFlag THEN 1 ELSE 0) + s.pic ) % 256

              pic     |-> 0 ]

              evts    |-> {},
              cpuFlag |-> FALSE,
              pic     |-> 0,
              version |-> 0,
              crc     |-> 0 ]
  /\ has_loaded = FALSE
  /\ loaded = [ time    |-> 0,

               pic     |-> 0 ]
  /\ corrupted = FALSE

                    opCount, inStep, lastError, dataRace >>

SwitchToPAL(t) ==
    /\ t \in PALThreads
    /\ t \in palThreads
    /\ activeThread' = t
    /\ callStack' = <<>>          \* PAL thread starts with empty stack
    /\ UNCHANGED << coreOwner, ownerThread, palThreads,
                    opCount, inStep, lastError, dataRace >>

SwitchToMain ==
    /\ activeThread # "Main"
    /\ activeThread' = "Main"
    /\ UNCHANGED << coreOwner, ownerThread, palThreads, callStack,
                    opCount, inStep, lastError, dataRace >>

\* Stutter step – allows the system to stay in the same state
Stutter ==
    UNCHANGED vars

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
Next ==
    \/ CreateInst
    \/ DestroyInst
    \/ MainEnterCore
    \/ MainExitCore
    \/ WrongThreadCall
    \/ BeginStep
    \/ EndStep
    \/ CoreCallPAL
    \/ ReturnFromPAL
    \/ \E t \in PALThreads : SpawnPALThread(t)
    \/ \E t \in PALThreads : SwitchToPAL(t)
    \/ SwitchToMain
    \/ Stutter

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety Invariant (captures the SAFETY PROPERTY)
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
SafetyInv ==
    /\ coreOwner \in {"None", "Main"}               \* core owned only by Main or none
    /\ dataRace = FALSE
    /\ (activeThread \in PALThreads =>                \* PAL threads never own core …
        /\ coreOwner = "None"
        /\ ~("CORE" \in { callStack[i] : i \in 1..Len(callStack) }))
    /\ (inStep => (activeThread = "Main" /\ coreOwner = "Main"))   \* step only on Main with core
    /\ (lastError = "OK" =>                        \* successful ops only when not a wrong‑thread call
        ~ (activeThread \in PALThreads /\ ownerThread = "Main"))

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Theorem (optional, for TLC)
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
THEOREM Spec => []SafetyInv

=============================================================================

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Variables
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* State predicate
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeOK ==
  /\ locked \in BOOLEAN
  /\ pc \in [ProcSet -> {"Loop", "Exchange", "Check", "CS", "ResetState"}]
  /\ old \in [ProcSet -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ stack \in [ProcSet -> Seq(Record)]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Initial state
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
  /\ locked = FALSE
  /\ pc = [p \in ProcSet |-> "Loop"]
  /\ old = [p \in ProcSet |-> FALSE]
  /\ stack = [p \in ProcSet |-> <<>>]

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Actions for a single process p
\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Loop(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "Loop"
  /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![p] = Append(@, [retPc |-> "CS", savedOld |-> FALSE])]
  /\ old' = [old EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "Exchange"]
  /\ UNCHANGED locked

Exchange(p) ==
  /\ pc[p] = "Exchange"
  /\ old' = [old EXCEPT ![p] = locked]
  /\ locked' = TRUE
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "Check"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack>>

        /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "Exchange"]

           /\ old' = [old EXCEPT ![p] = top.savedOld]
           /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![p] = Tail(@)]

  /\ pc[p] = "CS"
  /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![p] = Append(@, [retPc |-> "Loop", savedOld |-> FALSE])]
  /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![p] = "ResetState"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, old>>

AbortMsg        == [type |-> "Abort"]

CONSTANTS Data

VARIABLES AtoB, BtoA

Init ==
    /\ AtoB = << >>
    /\ BtoA = << >>

ASend(d) ==
    /\ d \in Data
    /\ Len(AtoB) < 3
    /\ AtoB' = Append(AtoB, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED BtoA

BRecv ==
    /\ Len(AtoB) > 0
    /\ AtoB' = Tail(AtoB)
    /\ UNCHANGED BtoA

BSend(d) ==
    /\ d \in Data
    /\ Len(BtoA) < 3
    /\ BtoA' = Append(BtoA, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED AtoB

ARecv ==
    /\ Len(BtoA) > 0
    /\ BtoA' = Tail(BtoA)
    /\ UNCHANGED AtoB

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Data: ASend(d)
    \/ BRecv
    \/ \E d \in Data: BSend(d)
    \/ ARecv

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<AtoB, BtoA>>

QueueSafety ==
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(AtoB) : AtoB[i] \in Data
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(BtoA) : BtoA[i] \in Data
    /\ Len(AtoB) <= 3
    /\ Len(BtoA) <= 3

\* -------------------------------------------------

    /\ decision = "None"

\* Actions
\* -------------------------------------------------

\* 2. RM receives Prepare and votes Yes
RMVoteYes(r) ==
    /\ r \in RMs
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ rmState[r] = "Init"
    /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "Prepared"]
    /\ votes'   = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = "Yes"]
    \/ UNCHANGED << phase, decision >>

\* 2. RM receives Prepare and votes No
RMVoteNo(r) ==
    /\ r \in RMs
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ rmState[r] = "Init"
    /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "Aborted"]
    /\ votes'   = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = "No"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, decision >>

\* 4. Coordinator decides after all votes are in
CoordinatorDecide ==
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ \A r \in RMs: votes[r] # "NoVote"
    /\ decision' = IF \A r \in RMs: votes[r] = "Yes"
                    THEN "Commit"
                    ELSE "Abort"
    /\ phase'    = "Decision"
    /\ UNCHANGED << rmState, votes >>

\* 6. RM receives a Commit decision and finalises
RMDecideCommit(r) ==
    /\ r \in RMs
    /\ phase = "Decision"
    /\ decision = "Commit"
    /\ rmState[r] = "Prepared"
    /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "Committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, decision, votes >>

\* 6. RM receives an Abort decision and finalises
RMDecideAbort(r) ==
    /\ r \in RMs
    /\ phase = "Decision"
    /\ decision = "Abort"
    /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![r] = "Aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, decision, votes >>

\* 7. Reset to start a new transaction
Reset ==
    /\ phase = "Decision"
    /\ \A r \in RMs: rmState[r] \in {"Committed", "Aborted"}
    /\ rmState' = [r \in RMs |-> "Init"]
    /\ phase'   = "Prepare"
    /\ decision' = "None"
    /\ votes'   = [r \in RMs |-> "NoVote"]

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Next-state relation
\* -------------------------------------------------

    \/ \E r \in RMs: RMVoteNo(r)
    \/ CoordinatorDecide
    \/ \E r \in RMs: RMDecideCommit(r)
    \/ \E r \in RMs: RMDecideAbort(r)
    \/ Reset

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Specification
\* -------------------------------------------------
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<rmState, phase, decision, votes>>

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Safety invariant (no mixture of commit and abort)
\* -------------------------------------------------
SafeAtomic ==
    ~(\E r1, r2 \in RMs :
          rmState[r1] = "Committed" /\ rmState[r2] = "Aborted")

\* -------------------------------------------------
\* Theorem (optional, for TLC)
\* -------------------------------------------------

\* The set of possible costs (one request per cost)

    /\ reqs = [c \in Costs |-> "Request"]
    /\ events = <<>>          \* empty sequence

    /\ bucket < MaxTokensInBucket
    /\ bucket' = bucket + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, events>>

    /\ \E c \in Costs :
          /\ reqs[c] = "Request"
          /\ c <= bucket                                 \* enough tokens for guard
          /\ bucket' = bucket - 1
          /\ reqs' = [reqs EXCEPT ![c] = "Done"]
          /\ events' = Append(events,
                               [type |-> "request",
                                cost |-> c,
                                bucketBefore |-> bucket])

Terminate ==
    /\ \A c \in Costs : reqs[c] = "Done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bucket, reqs, events>>

Next ==
    \/ AddToken
    \/ Request
    \/ Terminate

    /\ bucket \in 0..MaxTokensInBucket
    /\ reqs \in [Costs -> {"Request","Done"}]
    /\ events \in Seq(EventRec)
    /\ Len(events) <= 5

    \A i \in DOMAIN events :

VARIABLE collection           \* current set of items that have been added

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Init ==
    collection = {}

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Add ==
    \E v \in (values \ collection) :

    Init /\ [][Next]_<<collection>>

\* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
SafeCollection ==
    collection \subseteq values

---- MODULE IntClocks_Bounded_2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Integers, TLC

CONSTANTS BOUND, ERRMAX, Clocks

VARIABLES clock, err

(* ---------- Helper definitions ---------- *)

Abs(x) == IF x >= 0 THEN x ELSE -x

(* ---------- Initial state ---------- *)

Init ==
    /\ clock = [c \in Clocks |-> 0]
    /\ err    = 0

(* ---------- Actions ---------- *)

Tick(c) ==
    /\ c \in Clocks
    /\ clock[c] < BOUND
    /\ clock' = [clock EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED err

Reset(c) ==
    /\ c \in Clocks
    /\ clock' = [clock EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED err

DetectViolation ==
    /\ Abs(clock["c0"] - clock["c1"]) > BOUND
    /\ err < ERRMAX
    /\ err' = err + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Clocks : Tick(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clocks : Reset(c)
    \/ DetectViolation

(* ---------- Specification ---------- *)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<clock, err>>

(* ---------- Safety invariant ---------- *)

Safety ==
    /\ \A c \in Clocks : 0 <= clock[c] /\ clock[c] <= BOUND
    /\ 0 <= err /\ err <= ERRMAX

====

CONSTANTS RMs

VARIABLES rmState, decision

(*--- Constants for states and decisions ---*)
InitState      == "Init"
PreparedState  == "Prepared"
CommittedState == "Committed"
AbortedState   == "Aborted"

Undecided      == "Undecided"
CommitDec      == "Commit"
AbortDec       == "Abort"

RMStates   == {InitState, PreparedState, CommittedState, AbortedState}
Decisions  == {Undecided, CommitDec, AbortDec}

(*--- Initial state ---*)
Init ==
    /\ rmState = [rm \in RMs |-> InitState]
    /\ decision = Undecided

(*--- Actions ---*)

(* A resource manager in Init votes either Ready (Prepared) or No (Aborted) *)
RMPrepare ==
    \E rm \in RMs :
        /\ rmState[rm] = InitState
        /\ \/ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![rm] = PreparedState]
           \/ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![rm] = AbortedState]
        /\ decision' = decision

(* Coordinator decides once all votes are in *)
CoordinatorDecide ==
    /\ decision = Undecided
    /\ \A rm \in RMs : rmState[rm] \in {PreparedState, AbortedState}
    /\ IF \A rm \in RMs : rmState[rm] = PreparedState
          THEN decision' = CommitDec
          ELSE decision' = AbortDec
    /\ UNCHANGED rmState

(* Commit step for a prepared RM after a Commit decision *)
RMCommit ==
    \E rm \in RMs :
        /\ decision = CommitDec
        /\ rmState[rm] = PreparedState
        /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![rm] = CommittedState]
        /\ UNCHANGED decision

(* Abort step for a prepared or still‑Init RM after an Abort decision *)
RMAbort ==
    \E rm \in RMs :
        /\ decision = AbortDec
        /\ rmState[rm] \in {PreparedState, InitState}
        /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![rm] = AbortedState]
        \/ UNCHANGED decision

(* Stuttering step *)
Stutter == UNCHANGED << rmState, decision >>

Next == \/ RMPrepare
        \/ CoordinatorDecide
        \/ RMCommit
        \/ RMAbort
        \/ Stutter
